title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #13

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which surah is recited in every rak'ah of the prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Masad
   B. Al-Falaq
   C. An-Nasr
   D. Al-Fatiha

2. What did the Prophet say about smiling at your brother? (1 mark)
   A. It is only for the rich
   B. It is a kind of charity
   C. It is a sin
   D. It is forbidden

3. What is a benefit of saying Bismillah? (1 mark)
   A. It brings blessing to the food
   B. It cooks the food
   C. It makes food free
   D. It stops hunger forever

4. In the hadith about eating, from which part of the dish should we eat? (1 mark)
   A. The other person's side
   B. The part directly in front of us
   C. Any side we like
   D. The middle

5. What should a Muslim say before eating? (1 mark)
   A. Subhanallah
   B. Astaghfirullah
   C. Bismillah
   D. Alhamdulillah

6. The Prophet (S.A.W.) is reported to have raced with which wife? (1 mark)
   A. Khadija (R.A.)
   B. Hafsa (R.A.)
   C. Aisha (R.A.)
   D. Safiyya (R.A.)

7. What does the word "attribute" mean? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. A place
   C. A quality that describes someone
   D. A type of food

8. Why did Allah create angels? (1 mark)
   A. To be worshipped
   B. To worship Him and carry out His orders
   C. To play
   D. To rule over people

9. Which angel is in charge of rain and provision? (1 mark)
   A. Jibril
   B. Mikail
   C. Raqib
   D. Israfil

10. Who is the last prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Yahya
   B. Sulaiman
   C. Muhammad (S.A.W.)
   D. Isa

11. How is a light najasa cleaned? (1 mark)
   A. Wash seven times with soil
   B. Sprinkle water over it until it is wet
   C. Leave it
   D. Burn it

12. If you stretch your right arm toward the sunrise, you are facing roughly (1 mark)
   A. North
   B. East
   C. West
   D. South

13. How many parts of the body touch the ground in sujud? (1 mark)
   A. Two
   B. Five
   C. Seven
   D. Three

14. Which is a way of showing kindness to a working donkey? (1 mark)
   A. Overloading it
   B. Giving water and rest
   C. Leaving it in the sun
   D. Beating it

15. What is planting a tree from which animals or people eat counted as? (1 mark)
   A. A sin
   B. Charity for the planter
   C. A waste
   D. Nothing

16. What does haya mean? (1 mark)
   A. Pride
   B. Modesty
   C. Anger
   D. Speed

17. Which of these should be avoided? (1 mark)
   A. Neat school uniform
   B. Boys dressing to look like girls
   C. Shoes
   D. Clean clothes

18. Which is a question to ask before sharing? (1 mark)
   A. Is it true and kind?
   B. Is it new?
   C. Is it funny only?
   D. Will people like me?

19. Which is a media plan? (1 mark)
   A. No plan
   B. One hour after homework, no screens at prayer
   C. Games all day
   D. Screens at night

20. Which of these is print media? (1 mark)
   A. Radio
   B. Television
   C. Newspaper
   D. Film

21. Which is an evil of begging? (1 mark)
   A. Higher income
   B. More friends
   C. Loss of dignity
   D. Better skills

22. What is dua? (1 mark)
   A. A game
   B. A type of food
   C. Calling upon Allah and asking Him
   D. A journey

23. What is the dua for parents? (1 mark)
   A. Amin
   B. Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira
   C. Subhanallah
   D. Bismillah

24. What does "uff" mean in Qur'an 17:23? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. A greeting
   C. A song
   D. A word of impatience

25. Who is a "mjomba"? (1 mark)
   A. Cousin
   B. Father's sister
   C. Mother's brother
   D. Grandmother

26. What did the Prophet say about the one who cuts family ties? (1 mark)
   A. He will not enter Paradise
   B. He is rewarded
   C. He is honoured
   D. Nothing

27. How did Khadija support the Prophet? (1 mark)
   A. With comfort and her wealth
   B. By ignoring him
   C. By harming him
   D. By leaving him

28. What happened to Taif later? (1 mark)
   A. It disappeared
   B. Its people accepted Islam in later years
   C. It never changed
   D. It was destroyed

29. How did the leaders of Taif respond? (1 mark)
   A. They gave him gifts
   B. They joined him
   C. They accepted at once
   D. They rejected him rudely

30. What is Taif known for? (1 mark)
   A. Snow
   B. Deserts only
   C. Beaches
   D. Cooler weather, gardens and fruit

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Give the meanings of Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim and Al-Malik. (3 marks)

32. Write the meaning of the first verse of Surah Al-Ikhlas, "Qul huwallahu ahad". (2 marks)

33. Describe what a siwak is and how it is used. (3 marks)

34. State two reasons why a Muslim recites Al-Fatiha in every prayer. (2 marks)

35. Describe three good manners of eating apart from saying Bismillah. (3 marks)

36. How can planting a tree be an act of worship? (2 marks)

37. State three evils of begging. (3 marks)

38. Describe three Islamic manners to observe during games. (3 marks)

39. Describe how parents should correct children who do wrong. (4 marks)

40. Write the hadith on brushing teeth given in your syllabus. (2 marks)

41. Explain how Prophet Yusuf (A.S.) showed honesty and truthfulness. (3 marks)

42. Write a media plan for a week for a Grade 4 child following Islamic manners. (5 marks)

43. State three duties to grandparents. (3 marks)

44. Describe how to show patience to an elderly parent or grandparent. (3 marks)

45. Name the three types of najasaat. (3 marks)

46. Give the meanings of shangazi, mjomba and binamu. (3 marks)

47. Explain why we say Bismillah before eating. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #13 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Al-Fatiha
   Al-Fatiha is a pillar of every rak'ah.

2. B — It is a kind of charity
   A smile that cheers someone up is charity.

3. A — It brings blessing to the food
   We ask Allah to bless it.

4. B — The part directly in front of us
   The hadith says "eat what is directly in front of you".

5. C — Bismillah
   We begin by mentioning Allah's name.

6. C — Aisha (R.A.)
   Reports say he raced Aisha.

7. C — A quality that describes someone
   An attribute is a quality, like kindness.

8. B — To worship Him and carry out His orders
   Allah does not need them.

9. B — Mikail
   Scholars explain this duty of Mikail.

10. C — Muhammad (S.A.W.)
   Qur'an 33:40 calls him Seal of the Prophets.

11. B — Sprinkle water over it until it is wet
   Sprinkling is enough.

12. A — North
   Right arm east means facing north.

13. C — Seven
   Forehead, two palms, two knees, toes of both feet.

14. B — Giving water and rest
   Working animals need care.

15. B — Charity for the planter
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

16. B — Modesty
   Haya is modesty or shyness from wrong.

17. B — Boys dressing to look like girls
   Islam asks each to dress appropriately.

18. A — Is it true and kind?
   Truth and kindness first.

19. B — One hour after homework, no screens at prayer
   A plan sets limits.

20. C — Newspaper
   Print media is printed on paper.

21. C — Loss of dignity
   Begging lowers dignity.

22. C — Calling upon Allah and asking Him
   Dua means supplication.

23. B — Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira
   A dua asking mercy for parents.

24. D — A word of impatience
   Do not say even "uff".

25. C — Mother's brother
   Mjomba is mother's brother.

26. A — He will not enter Paradise
   A warning in Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

27. A — With comfort and her wealth
   She supported him fully.

28. B — Its people accepted Islam in later years
   A delegation later accepted Islam.

29. D — They rejected him rudely
   They refused.

30. D — Cooler weather, gardens and fruit
   It is on higher ground.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ar-Rahman: the Most Kind; Ar-Rahim: the Most Merciful; Al-Malik: the King and Owner.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: Say: He is Allah, the One.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for "Say" and 1 mark for "Allah is One".

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is a small stick from a tree such as the arak. One end is chewed to make fibres, and it is rubbed on the teeth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for stick or tree, 1 mark for chewing the end, 1 mark for rubbing the teeth.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is a pillar of the prayer, and it praises Allah and asks Him for guidance.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wash hands before, eat with the right hand, eat from in front, do not criticise food, do not waste.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each manner.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: People or animals eat from it, and this counts as charity for the planter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for charity and 1 mark for eating from it.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: Loss of dignity, laziness, wasted resources, lies, harm to children.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: Dress modestly, keep the times of prayer, avoid cheating and insults, respect others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each manner.

39. (4 marks)
   Answer: With wisdom and gentleness, not cruelty. They should explain, listen, forgive small mistakes and set a good example.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: Brushing of teeth is a means of purification of the mouth and pleases Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for purification and 1 mark for pleasing Allah.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: He refused to do wrong when tempted, he feared Allah, and stayed honest even in prison. The Qur'an calls him Siddiq.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for refusing wrong, 1 mark for honesty in hardship, 1 mark for Siddiq.

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: Screen time limit after homework; no screens at prayer or meal times; educational and Islamic content; ask permission; tell an adult if unsafe.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid item up to 5.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Respect and greet them, help them, visit them, listen to their stories, make dua.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Listen without complaining, help them to walk and eat, speak gently.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Mukhaffafah (light), mutawassitah (medium) and mughalladha (heavy).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: Shangazi: father's sister; mjomba: mother's brother; binamu: cousin.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: We ask for Allah's blessing and remember that food is from Him. It makes eating an act of worship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.
